page_note: Page is dominantly substrate teaching: a systematic exposition of the five chronological powers (lord-of-year, lord-of-month, lord-of-day, lord-of-hour, lord-of-moment) set in the sphere of the zodiac, mapped to the diminishing lifespans of generations from Adam onwards. The cosmology→biology mapping (rule of years yields long-lived offspring; rule of months yields shorter-lived offspring) stays internal to the cosmic system. Editorial seam appears at segs 4-6 (Illuminator frame addressing 'this catechumen who had asked him') — frame is institutional, but it introduces a substantive cosmological question that triggers the substrate teaching. Damage ratio is high (37.5%) but the structure of the teaching is still recoverable.
